Date August 28th 1932.

Subject (in full) Re one A. Bowick

Made by D. S. Beloshenko. Forwarded by C. I. T. Gillivray

Sir,
With to the attached I beg to report that enquiries were
continued by the undersigned but no trace as to the whereabouts of
A. Bowick has been found.
M. M. Booykis at present employed at 96 Rue Cardinal XXX
Mercier, Taylor Garage, was interviewed and it was proved that he
is not the person who received the money from Mr. J. H. Hind.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
D S Beloshenko
D. S. 211.

Oy

由 D. S. Beloshenko 撰写。由 C. I. T. Gillivray 转呈

先生，
随函附上相关文件，卑职谨此报告，经卑职继续调查，仍未发现 A. Bowick 的下落踪迹。
目前在 Cardinal Mercier 路（原文不清，似为红衣主教梅尔西埃路）96号泰勒汽车行（Taylor Garage）受雇的 M. M. Booykis 已接受问询，经查证，他并非从 J. H. Hind 先生处收取款项之人。

卑职谨此，
顺致敬意，
D S Beloshenko

Central Station,
REPORT
Date August 23, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Re one A. Bowick.

Made by D. S. Beloshenko Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
With reference to the attached memo from Mr. H. M. Hind, I
beg to report that on 18-8-32 he was interviewed by the undersigned
and the descriptions of the persons concerned were obtained. It
was also learned from him that upon receiving the money, A. Bowick
stated that he is a musician and the money required by him for
the redemption of his violin from the pawnshop.
Enquiries were made by the undersigned amongst the Russian
drivers and the musicians as well but no one was found who heard
about this man.

[Signature]
D. S. 211.

事由（全称）关于一名叫 A. Bowick 的人。

由 D. S. Beloshenko 撰写 由 [签名] 转呈

先生，
关于随附的 H. M. Hind 先生的备忘录，卑职谨此报告，该人已于1932年8月18日接受卑职问询，并获取了相关人员的体貌特征描述。卑职还从他处获悉，A. Bowick 在收到钱款时声称自己是一名音乐家，所需钱款用于从当铺赎回其小提琴。
卑职也在俄国司机和音乐家中进行了查询，但无人表示听说过此人。

[签名]
D. S. 211号警员。

MANAGER 15659
GENERAL OFFICE 12300
Phoenix Assurance Company, Ltd.
INCORPORATED IN GREAT BRITAIN
FAR EASTERN BRANCH
15 PEKING ROAD, SHANGHAI.
15th August 1932.

Memorandum
To
Shanghai Municipal Police

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. D 39442 Date 6/8/32）

At the end of June a young Russian called at this office,
and represented himself as the chauffeur of Mr Evamy of Dairen,
whom I know well. He gave his name as A. Bovick, and said that
he was in temporary difficulties, borrowing $10 from me. I now
hear from Mr Evamy that he knows nothing of this man. I mention
the matter in case he has been imposing on others.

H. V. Hind.

500 2-11-31 M.P.C.

备忘录

上海公共租界工部局警务处

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部登记处 编号 D 39442 日期 1932年8月6日）

六月底，一名年轻的俄国人来到本办事处，自称是大连 Evamy 先生的司机，而我对 Evamy 先生非常熟悉。他报姓名为 A. Bovick，并称自己暂时陷入困境，向我借款10元。现我从 Evamy 先生处获悉，他对此人一无所知。我提及此事，以防此人招摇撞骗他人。

H. V. Hind.

500 2-11-31 M.P.C.
